about_the_game:
With the help of your ally, the Holy Flask, guide Sepan to the lost Seven Flasks of Power.

Why do the inhabitants of this world seem unable to see reality? What is that scream far away ? Will you find your way through the darkness? Will you survive this unpredictable world?
Dive into Sepan and the Seven Flasks, overcome obstacles, and gather all the Seven Flasks.

The Holy Flask watches over you.

Gameplay

  • Story Mode with three difficulty levels

  • Several mini-games integrated into Story Mode

  • Four unlockable mini-games: runner, reflex, rhythm, and QTE

  • Local and global leaderboards for mini-games

  • [Optional] Twitch integration: allows viewers to interact with certain mini-games

Unlockable Mini-Games

  • Scooter Run (runner): three difficulty levels, endless mode, Twitch chat integration

  • Dance (rhythm): three dance styles, non-stop mode, Twitch chat integration

  • Reflex vs. a dog (QTE): three difficulty levels, non-stop mode

  • Chain Jumps (timing): three difficulty levels, non-stop mode

Features

  • A story mixing complexity, mystery, and humor

  • Numerous references to internet culture and video games

  • Hidden characters to discover

  • A Stalker lurking in the shadows, to avoid at all costs

We would like to thank the Holy Flask for its exceptional contribution.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Linux distribution released after 2018
  • Processor: x86_32 CPU with SSE2 support, x86_64 CPU with SSE4.2 support, ARMv7 or ARMv8 CPU
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with OpenGL 3.3 support
  • Storage: 250 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Stéréo
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K, AMD Ryzen 5 1600, Raspberry Pi 5 with overclocking
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated graphics with OpenGL 4.6 or Vulkan 1.2 support
  • Storage: 250 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Stéréo
